name: gamedraw
description: A small, single-file-ish vector drawing web app. The canvas engine is a custom **native SVG** renderer written in **ClojureScript** and run in the browser with [Scittle](https://github.com/babashka/scittle) + [Reagent](https://reagent-project.github.io/). There is no build step: `src/main.cljs` is evaluated directly by Scittle.
